tagline: Reach Claude users at the exact moment they're picking tools.
_help: One card after the top 5 results. To run a real sponsor: set demo:false and fill name/tagline/url (logo = image URL, optional); no code change needed. keywords (optional): show only when the prompt contains one of them; empty = every prompt. demo:true labels the card 'Example sponsor' and should point url at /sponsor/. active:false shows a plain house card linking to /sponsor/.
